The draft preserves both advisories under distinct qualified ids and accurately states their different subject matter. Its wording and zero-readiness effect match adopted D-103/D-104 and the earlier D-013/D-015/D-035/D-042 recording class. No MUST-FIX or SHOULD-FIX survives; CONSENT is warranted.
